items.text:
У Ostranauts огромный потенциал, концепция космического бомжа-утилизатора реально затягивает. Но техническая сторона сейчас — это тихий ужас. Чем дольше идет одна игровая сессия, тем сильнее всё ломается. Начинают вылезать бесконечные ошибки, намертво пропадает интерфейс, а некоторые действия персонажей просто перестают работать. 

[b]Вдобавок к багам очень сильно душнят две вещи:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Катастрофическая нехватка места. Система хранения лута сделана максимально неудобно, из-за чего менеджмент вещей превращается в бесконечную рутину.
[*]Абсолютно тупой ИИ экипажа. Напарники постоянно творят дичь. Стоит включить высокую скорость времени, как они банально забывают надевать шлем от скафандра и просто задыхаются.
[/list]
Потенциал у игры топовый, но сейчас это слишком сырой продукт. Лучше дождаться.
items.text_zh:
Ostranauts拥有巨大的潜力，太空拾荒流浪汉的概念确实很吸引人。但技术层面目前简直是一场无声的恐怖。一局游戏进行得越久，一切就坏得越厉害。无尽的错误开始冒出来，界面会彻底消失，而角色的一些动作干脆停止工作。

[b]除了bug之外，还有两件事非常让人憋屈：[/b]
[list]
[*]灾难性的空间不足。战利品存储系统做得极其不方便，导致物品管理变成无尽的例行公事。
[*]绝对愚蠢的船员AI。同伴们不断干蠢事。一旦开启高时间速度，他们就会干脆忘记戴上宇航服的头盔，然后直接窒息。
[/list]
这款游戏的潜力是顶级的，但现在它还是一个过于半成品的产品。最好再等等。

items.text:
Unfortunately, I cannot in good conscience recommend this game. I like the concept of it - starting with a small ship in mortgage, access to a ship boneyard for a nominal fee (or for free if you're good at hiding from cops) and some skills in building ships and tearing them apart. Simulated electrical systems, pressure, malfunctions such as fires or navigation station software bugging out. Build out your ship, travel the Solar System, do some stuff - questing, trading, asteriod mining, even participating in a war, good stuff, good ideas.

The problem is bad implementation. The deeper you go into the game, the more problems you find with various systems. The gases don't go through adiabatic cooling, which is reasonable for a game, so any gases you pump into your ship are at room temperature, but *sometimes* re-pressurising a room ends up with it being barely a few Kelvin hot. Characters that are prone to choosing the way around the ship if they can, doesn't matter if that way happens to go outside and they have no EVA suit on (space, remember?). Autotasking, which is basically required if you don't want to click your character through installing 400 floors and 80 walls one by one, is very bad in a lot of ways that are too long to go into details here. Barely anything happens during time skip, so if you want any work done, you'll have to let your characters do the work and go watch Youtube or something. Characters still can't replace batteries in tools without dropping flat batteries on the ground instead of properly inserting them into chargers. And speaking of tools, they will choose the first tool they find when you need one, not "the best in their inventory" or anything like that, so you need to take care to not leave old tools in any reachable places. CO2 filters never get used up, so while CO2 buildup is still bad for your character, that particular system is half-baked. Item sorting in kiosks for buying/selling is arcane.

Flight is Newtonian... to a point, it doesn't simulate gravity faithfully enough (in my opinion) and the navigation station doesn't give you enough tools to utilize the fact. Fuel isn't accounted in ship mass, which you could argue is a gameplay decision, but cargo in cargo pods does count in ship mass, so I dunno. Autopilot for interplanetary travel cheats, uses too much fuel and still smacks you into planets sometimes.

I could go on and on, but you get the idea. I have two problems with this game. I played this game for 250 hours total, about 150 hours back when I just bought it and about 100 hours near and after release. This game pulled me in enough that I tried to figure out and work around all this problems, be it by modding, adapting my processes to the s*** factor, or any other ways. But at some point my will just broke. This game is an exercise in frustration, and in the end frustration subsumes any amount of enjoyment I got out of this game. The game is full of bugs, Discord bug forum is full of bugs, and only a small amount of them gets acknowledged and even smaller about fixed. The devs say "report the bugs", but even after you report it *and provide source code for a mod that fixes it*, chances are the bug will stay in the game for weeks ahead. I don't have patience to wait for months, but some well-known problems have stayed for years, apparently, so make what you will of it. That's the first and the biggest problem. The second, as the dev's community manager eloquently put it in Discord, "this game's elevator pitch is Firefly episode generator". There is a reason I'm indifferent to Firefly as opposed to Star Trek, and it's the setting. This game won't tell you power draw or any other specs for spaceship equipment. It won't tell you how much thrust thrusters produce or how far sensors can detect things. You're supposed to wing it. I don't like it.

By the way, I like Rimworld. Rimworld is also a "story generator". It's also a lot, lot, lot better implementation-wise than this game. Don't get fooled by comparison.

So there it is. Apparently this game has a deep simulation for characters relations, mental needs etcetc, but it was too arcane for me to figure it out, so I just ignored it. As is the norm for the game, it won't tell you anything, you're supposed to figure things out. Maybe this is not a one-guy-or-small-team-flying-spaceship simulation game but a dating simulator in space with elements of shipbuilding? I dunno. If you want to get the game, make absolutely sure your expectations match what it is.
items.text_zh:
遗憾的是，我无法凭良心推荐这款游戏。我喜欢它的概念——从一艘还在按揭的小船开始，可以花点小钱（或者如果你擅长躲警察就免费）进入飞船坟场，还有一些建造和拆解飞船的技能。模拟电气系统、压力、火灾或导航站软件故障等故障。建造你的飞船，在太阳系中旅行，做些事情——任务、贸易、小行星采矿，甚至参与战争，好东西，好想法。

问题在于糟糕的实现。你在游戏中越深入，就会发现各种系统的问题越多。气体不会经历绝热冷却，这对游戏来说还算合理，所以你泵入飞船的任何气体都是室温的，但*有时候*给房间重新加压后，它却只有几开尔文的温度。角色倾向于选择绕飞船的路，如果可能的话，不管那条路是否会通到外面，而他们又没穿EVA服（太空，记得吗？）。自动任务分配，如果你不想一个个点击角色安装400块地板和80面墙，基本上就是必需的，但它在很多方面都非常糟糕，细节太长这里就不展开了。时间跳过期间几乎什么都不会发生，所以如果你想完成任何工作，你就得让角色干活，自己去看YouTube什么的。角色仍然无法更换工具里的电池，而是把没电的电池扔在地上，而不是正确地插入充电器。说到工具，当你需要一个工具时，他们会选择找到的第一个工具，而不是“他们库存中最好的”之类的，所以你得小心，不要把旧工具留在任何可触及的地方。CO2过滤器永远不会用完，所以虽然CO2积累对你的角色仍然有害，但那个特定系统是半生不熟的。售货亭里买卖物品的分类方式神秘莫测。

飞行是牛顿式的……到一定程度，它（在我看来）没有足够忠实地模拟重力，导航站也没有给你足够的工具来利用这一事实。燃料不计入飞船质量，你可以说这是游戏性决定，但货舱里的货物确实计入飞船质量，所以我不知道。行星际旅行的自动驾驶作弊，使用过多燃料，有时还会把你撞进行星。

我可以继续说下去，但你明白意思了。我对这款游戏有两个问题。我总共玩了250小时，大约150小时是我刚买的时候，大约100小时是在发布前后。这款游戏足够吸引我，以至于我试图弄清楚并绕过所有这些问题，无论是通过模组、调整我的流程来适应这坨屎，还是其他方式。但到了某个时候，我的意志就崩溃了。这款游戏是一场挫折的练习，最终挫折感吞没了我从中获得的任何乐趣。游戏充满bug，Discord的bug论坛充满bug，只有一小部分被承认，被修复的就更少了。开发者说“报告bug”，但即使你报告了*并且提供了修复它的模组源代码*，这个bug很可能还会在游戏中停留数周。我没有耐心等几个月，但一些众所周知的问题显然已经存在多年了，所以你自己看着办吧。这是第一个也是最大的问题。第二个，正如开发者的社区经理在Discord上雄辩地说的，“这款
游戏的电梯游说是“萤火虫剧集生成器”。我对《萤火虫》不像对《星际迷航》那样感兴趣是有原因的，那就是它的设定。这款游戏不会告诉你飞船设备的功耗或任何其他规格。它不会告诉你推进器产生多少推力，或者传感器能探测到多远的东西。你应该自己随机应变。我不喜欢这样。

顺便说一句，我喜欢《环世界》。《环世界》也是一个“故事生成器”。在实现方面，它也比这款游戏好得多得多得多。别被这种比较骗了。

所以就是这样。显然，这款游戏对角色关系、心理需求等有深度模拟，但对我来说太晦涩难懂了，所以我干脆忽略了它。就像这款游戏的常态一样，它什么都不会告诉你，你应该自己去弄明白。也许这不是一个单人或小团队驾驶飞船的模拟游戏，而是一个带有造船元素的太空约会模拟器？我不知道。如果你想买这款游戏，一定要绝对确保你的期望与它的实际内容相符。

items.text:
I wish I could recommend this. I LOVE the ideas and really enjoy playing it most of the time. But the game keeps trying to ruin the experience.

My biggest gripe: I love designing ships, but how do you make a ship editor that doesn't give you the ship diagnostics of the ship you're building? How many thrusters and fuel am i going to need to make this move and yet not knock out my character from G-forces? Who knows, I have to add up the mass of all the pieces I'm using individually (100's of pieces). The wiki doesn't have the mass. The editor doesn't show the mass. Heck, right clicking a piece in an active game doesn't show the mass. Only picking up an uninstalled piece in game shows you the mass. I have no way to know if i'm building an immovable brick or a sponge attached to a firework!

Positives: The salvaging and space navigation are really fun, the modular nav station interface is awesome, the potential is huge. It feels like space is dangerous, exciting and full of adventure.

Negatives: "Socialising" is soulless and a chore. I insult someone, they flirt, i flirt back, they say they're not interested. Your choices affect nothing. But there are negative effects if you don't do it. And of course, the ship editor is a disappointment.
items.text_zh:
我希望我能推荐这款游戏。我热爱这些创意，而且大多数时候真的很享受玩它。但游戏总是试图毁掉这种体验。

我最大的不满：我喜欢设计飞船，但你怎么能做一个飞船编辑器，却不给你正在建造的飞船的飞船诊断信息？我需要多少推进器和燃料才能让它动起来，同时又不让我的角色因G力而昏过去？谁知道呢，我得把使用的所有部件的质量一个个加起来（数百个部件）。Wiki上没有质量数据。编辑器不显示质量。见鬼，在正在进行的游戏里右键点击一个部件也不显示质量。只有在游戏里捡起一个未安装的部件才会显示质量。我根本没办法知道我是在造一块动不了的砖头，还是造一个绑在烟花上的海绵！

优点：打捞和太空航行真的很有趣，模块化的导航站界面很棒，潜力巨大。感觉太空既危险又刺激，充满冒险。

缺点：“社交”毫无灵魂，是件苦差事。我侮辱某人，他们调情，我调情回去，他们说他们不感兴趣。你的选择毫无影响。但如果你不做，就会有负面效果。当然，飞船编辑器也令人失望。

observations.description: 社交对话中的选择对结果没有任何影响

items.text:
Oh my God it's so frustrating just how awful this game is because it could really be something special. Put in about 53 hours since 1.0 in the last few days, and for the most part I thought things had really improved significantly since I played in late 2024, but it's just not worth the frustrations. This should not have been released, and I refuse to believe the developer doesn't know that. So why? Running out of funds and need to push it out to get another round of suckers?

Authority/Pirate ships will randomly try to dock with you which is fine and adds some excitement. However what is NOT fine is that they blast towards you at ridiculous speeds and dock with you while travelling >100 m/s which obliterates both of your ships. I had to reload a save 10 times trying to maintain a relative velocity with the authority ship below 100 m/s just so they could dock with me. One of those times I managed to do it and the NPC just stood on their bridge for 5 minutes doing nothing. So, I requested undocking permission, which was granted, but after trying to release clamps they walked up to me at my navigation terminal and identified me as a criminal. Reload again, and again, and eventually able to show them my license and go about my business.

AI crew is still absolutely and despicably abhorrent. Hygiene low? Better brush my teeth. Oh - oops I'm wearing an EVA suite in a vacuum, silly me I'll go back to work. Oh hygiene is still low, let me walk back to the same spot that I just failed to brush my teeth at and try again. Nope still in an EVA suit in a vacuum. Well, back on the ship with perfect atmosphere I'll try brushing my teeth. Damn! I am still wearing a helmet, guess I'll suffer. 

Comfortable bunk in the ship, accessible and available. Crew will be standing NEXT TO the bunk and decide to walk to the air lock (which is pulled to a vacuum) without a helmet and sleep on the floor. Perfectly fine when controlling the crew and forcing them to use the bed.

Otherwise all psychological and physiological needs were met with this crew member after manually intervening - until I decided to have the captain sleep, and fast-forward 6 hours. Suddenly they were just having a miserable existence and wanted to quit. Well, they got locked in the airlock and the turbo pumps suddenly and mysteriously turned on and slowly suffocated, so at least there was a good ending.

Eventually flying to Venus with torch drive, trash AI pirate attempts to intercept me - probably a coffin or something. Can't catch me, but after a couple hours and having gone from 100m/s - >100km/s relative to OKLG they are still chasing me. How can they have that much N2 (IR sensor shows no reactor)? Given up on this save as I know that once I reach drift phase they will eventually catch up, travelling at some insane speed and just slam into me anyway.

Restored He-3 tank while in transit, also one of the pellet feeders. He-3 went from 2000Kg to full and after that no longer losing any fuel despite reactor running at full flow and still burning. Great time.

Loaded up that save after a day and hit with mortgage for my ship as it was 00:00 on 9/1. What's this? Also a mortgage for 00:00 8/1? That's before the start date on the damn game. 

Just save yourself the pain and frustration and steer clear.
items.text_zh:
哦我的天哪，这游戏烂得让人太沮丧了，因为它本来真的可以很特别。自1.0以来，这几天我玩了大约53个小时，大部分时候我觉得自从2024年末玩过之后，情况确实有了显著改善，但那些挫败感还是不值得。这游戏本不该被发布，我拒绝相信开发者不知道这一点。那为什么呢？资金耗尽了，需要把它推出去再骗一轮冤大头？

权威/海盗船会随机尝试与你对接，这没问题，还增添了一些刺激感。然而没问题是——它们以荒谬的速度朝你冲过来，并在以超过100米/秒的速度航行时与你对接，这会摧毁你们双方的飞船。我不得不重新读档10次，试图与权威船保持低于100米/秒的相对速度，好让它们能与我对接。其中一次我成功做到了，结果那个NPC就站在他们的舰桥上5分钟什么也不做。于是，我请求解除对接许可，获得了批准，但在尝试释放锁扣之后，他们走到我所在的导航终端前，把我认定为罪犯。再次读档，一次又一次，最终才得以向他们出示我的执照，继续做我的事。

AI船员依然绝对且可鄙地令人憎恶。卫生度低？最好去刷牙。哦——糟糕，我在真空中穿着EVA服，我真傻，我回去工作吧。哦卫生度还是低，让我走回刚才刷牙失败的那个地方再试一次。不行，还是在真空中穿着EVA服。好吧，回到大气完美的飞船上，我来试着刷牙。该死！我还是戴着头盔，那就忍着吧。

飞船上有一张舒适的双层床，可到达且可用。船员会站在双层床旁边，然后决定不戴头盔走到气闸（已被抽成真空）并睡在地板上。当控制船员并强迫他们使用床时，一切完全正常。

除此之外，在手动干预之后，这名船员的心理和生理需求都得到了满足——直到我决定让船长睡觉，并快进6个小时。突然间他们就过着悲惨的生活，想要辞职。好吧，他们被锁在气闸里，涡轮泵突然而神秘地启动了，他们慢慢窒息而死，所以至少有个好结局。

最终用火炬驱动器飞往金星，垃圾AI海盗试图拦截我——大概是个棺材之类的东西。追不上我，但几个小时后，相对于OKLG从100米/秒变成了>100公里/秒，他们还在追我。他们怎么会有那么多N2（红外传感器显示没有反应堆）？放弃这个存档了，因为我知道一旦我进入漂移阶段，他们最终会追上来，以某种疯狂的速度飞行，然后照样撞上我。

在运输途中恢复了He-3储罐，还有一个燃料丸供给器。He-3从2000公斤变成了满罐，之后尽管反应堆全流量运行并仍在燃烧，却不再消耗任何燃料。真是好时光。

一天后加载那个存档，因为到了9月1日00:00，就收到了我飞船的抵押贷款。这是什么？还有8月1日00:00的抵押贷款？那是在这该死的游戏开始日期之前。

还是省省你的痛苦和挫败吧，离它远点。

Still some game-breaking bugs, character not responding to instructions, save wiped after restart
However the Devs are extremely proactive and responsive. 
If you enjoyed neo-scavenger and other games like shipbreaker/kerbal then this is a must buy!
items.text_zh:
仍然有一些破坏游戏的bug，角色不响应指令，重启后存档被清空
不过开发者们极其积极主动且响应迅速。
如果你喜欢《新拾荒者》以及《拆船者》/《坎巴拉》之类的游戏，那么这绝对是必买之作！

items.text:
This game has a lot of promise but as it stands it's far too buggy to even be in early access, this is pre-alpha state at best, I'm going to come back to this in a few months when hopefully some of the game breaking issues have been fixed but for now I cannot recommend it.

Edit: Removal of the ability to access things on the floor through the inventory has essentially killed this for me, it makes so many simple things a thousand times harder for no real reason.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏很有前途，但就目前而言，它的bug太多，甚至不该处于抢先体验阶段，充其量只是前alpha状态。我打算几个月后再回来看看，希望那时一些破坏游戏的问题已经修复，但就目前而言，我无法推荐它。

编辑：移除了通过物品栏访问地板上物品的能力，这基本上让我对这款游戏失去了兴趣，它让许多简单的事情变得难上千倍，而且没有任何真正的理由。
